title: 第13章 嗷呜第14章 情愫
lines: 在确定蓝雨伯和陈大朋都死透后，许平秋心中才敢放松，身上那股一直强撑着他的精气神，也随之泄去，他双腿一软，险些便要瘫倒在地。
一种龟裂的痛伤感从体内传来，刚刚陈大朋那一掌其实已经震伤了许平秋的脏腑，只是因为肾上腺素的缘故，让他第一时间没有感到痛。
眼下要不是有玉元丹的药力在体内不断流转，温润着受损的经脉和脏腑，恐怕又要去世了。
本着是药三分毒的定律，许平秋也并没有多吃，只是又吞了两颗下去，吃到九分毒的分量。
随后他握紧长剑来到了乐临清的身旁。
此时乐临清艰难的撑着身子，肌肤被桃红晕染，眼眸微眯着，嘴中无意识的发出难受的呜吟声，在察觉到许平秋的靠近，她颤抖的身子想要退缩，但却显得无力可欺。
“别怕，是我。”许平秋忍住心中的蠢蠢欲动的念头，轻声说道。
乐临清像是认出了来人是谁，没有再躲避，微微仰着头，哼哼的发出难受讨要般的声响。
许平秋蹲下身，想要将她抱起，但刚一接触，乐临清身子骨就主动拥了上来，搂紧着许平秋，漫无目的的蹭弄着。
在欲神瘴的影响下，乐临清就好似一团炽烈的火焰，此刻只想将拥抱的许平秋给融化，然后汇入自己的体内。
她的心中只剩下了情情爱爱，可是她却不知道如何更进一步，只能凭着感觉青涩的作祟。
湿热的呼吸来回交织，她的螓首在许平秋的脖颈间不断来回蹭弄着，发丝刺挠着脖颈，一种可爱但又十分性感诱人的声响从乐临清红唇发出，响在许平秋耳中，直入心中。
许平秋左手抱着乐临清，右手提着长剑，忍受着乐临清的挑逗，艰难的站起身，直感觉她像是一个磨人精。
这比起陈大朋扔出的什么丹药都更加勾人心弦。
但危机并没有完全解除，因为白虎和那只妖兽还不知鹿死谁手，它俩任何一头回来，许平秋感觉自己都不会是对手。
虽然刚刚白虎很配合自己，但眼下乐临清神智不清，自己就是一个弱鸡，还受了内伤，加上丹药的诱惑，许平秋不敢赌它的野性。
尤其是它与那头妖兽搏杀，一旦见血，野性大概率会被激上来。
至于杀了陈大鹏的那一手御剑，许平秋感觉这算是走了狗屎运。
他根本不知道是怎么做到的，只能感觉这长剑和他有一种微弱的关联，心念想要复刻刚刚的操作只会令眉心一阵刺痛。
所以这狗屎运只能走一次，还想着靠运气爆种不太现实，眼下还是要先找个地方苟命才是正道。
许平秋环顾四周，地势平坦，难以找到藏身之地，来时方向的密林倒是可以，远处的山脉或许也不错，但是有点远了。
正当许平秋审视的时候，远处一道白色的身影忽然一晃一晃的向着这里跑来。
这不由令他紧张了起来，握紧了长剑。
“嗷呜~”
白虎发出了一声中气不足的叫声，它的一只腿已经瘸了，像是被咬伤，身上的皮毛也不再如刚刚那般整洁白净，沾染了不少血色。
但这没有显得它更加狰狞，反而显得它有种狼狈不堪，可怜兮兮的感觉。
content_en:
After confirming that both Lan Yubo and Chen Dapeng were dead, Xu Pingqiu dared to relax. The energy that had been supporting him also drained away. His legs weakened and he almost collapsed to the ground.
A crackling pain and sadness came from within his body. Chen Dapeng's palm just now had actually shocked Xu Pingqiu's internal organs, but because of the adrenaline, he didn't feel the pain for the first time.
If it weren't for the power of the Jade Yuan Dan that was constantly flowing through his body, warming the damaged meridians and internal organs, he might have died again.
In line with the law that medicine is three-quarters poisonous, Xu Pingqiu did not take more, but swallowed two more pills, achieving nine-cent poisonous content.
Then he clenched his sword and came to Le Linqing's side.
At this time, Le Linqing was holding herself up with difficulty, her skin was smeared with pink, her eyes were slightly squinted, and she unconsciously let out an uncomfortable moan. When she noticed Xu Pingqiu's approach, her trembling body wanted to retreat, but she seemed powerless to bully her.
"Don't be afraid, it's me." Xu Pingqiu said softly, suppressing the thoughts in his heart.
"Well..."
Le Linqing seemed to have recognized who the person was, and did not avoid it anymore. He raised his head slightly and made an uncomfortable and begging sound.
Xu Pingqiu knelt down and wanted to pick her up, but as soon as she made contact, Le Linqing took the initiative to hug her, hugged Xu Pingqiu tightly, and rubbed her aimlessly.
Under the influence of the Miasma of Desire, Le Linqing was like a blazing flame. At this moment, he just wanted to melt the hugging Xu Pingqiu and then merge it into his body.
There was only love and love left in her heart, but she didn't know how to go further, so she could only rely on her youthful feelings.
The moist and hot breaths intertwined back and forth, her head kept rubbing back and forth on Xu Pingqiu's neck, and the hair thorns scratched his neck. A cute but very sexy and alluring sound came from Le Linqing's red lips, ringing in Xu Pingqiu's ears and straight into his heart.
Xu Pingqiu held Le Linqing in his left hand and held the long sword in his right hand. He endured Le Linqing's teasing and stood up with difficulty, feeling that she was like a grinder.
This is more attractive than any pills thrown by Chen Dapeng.
But the crisis has not been completely resolved, because the white tiger and the monster still don't know who will win. If either of them comes back, Xu Pingqiu feels that he will not be his opponent.
Although the white tiger was very cooperative with him just now, Le Linqing was now unconscious, he was a weakling, and had suffered internal injuries. Coupled with the temptation of the elixir, Xu Pingqiu did not dare to bet on its wild nature.
Especially when it fights with that monster, once it sees blood, its wild nature will most likely be aroused.
As for the sword that killed Chen Dapeng, Xu Pingqiu felt that it was just bad luck.
He had no idea how he did it. He could only feel that there was a weak connection between the sword and him. Trying to repeat the operation just now would only make his eyebrows sting.
So this piece of shit luck can only happen once, and it is unrealistic to rely on luck to achieve success. At the moment, the right way is to find a place to survive.
Xu Pingqiu looked around. The terrain was flat and it was difficult to find a hiding place. The dense forest in the direction from where he came was fine. The mountains in the distance might also be good, but they were a bit far away.
Just as Xu Pingqiu was inspecting it, a white figure in the distance suddenly swayed towards here.
This made him nervous and he tightened his grip on the sword.
"Ouch~"
The white tiger let out a breathless cry. One of its legs was already lame, as if it had been bitten. The fur on its body was no longer as clean and white as before, and was stained with blood.
But this does not make it more ferocious, but instead makes it look embarrassed and pitiful.
